# Codex changelog

## November 20, 2026

- Codex 0.171.0 (Nov 20): Added GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra to model catalogs, with Sol as the default.
- Added GPT-6.1 Terra, GPT-5.3-Codex and gpt-6.2-luna to the model picker.

## 2026-10-02

GPT-5.5 retires from Codex for users signed in with ChatGPT, effective Oct 14. Use GPT-6.2 Sol instead.

<h2>September 15, 2026</h2>
<p>We introduced <code>gpt-6-astra</code> in the CLI.</p>
